fields.subject: ShardsValues
fields.where: the invoked overload is one of the two List<> forms whose records parameter is one key-component narrower than its own generic type parameters: ShardListForeign<TRecord, TChild>(short shardId, List<ShardKey<TRecord>> records) at ShardsValues.cs line 255, or ShardListForeign<TRecord, TChild, TGrandChild>(short shardId, List<ShardKey<TRecord>> records) at line 324
fields.trigger: it is called with a null records argument
fields.response: pass the null through its forwarding cast unchanged, because a null reference is assignable to any reference type regardless of the cast's target type, and then throw a System.NullReferenceException when the forwarded overload (ShardListForeign<TRecord, TChild> at line 265, or ShardListForeign<TRecord, TChild, TGrandChild> at line 337) attempts to enumerate the null records argument in its foreach loop
fields.postcondition: no ShardsValues is returned, and the exception is attributed to the forwarded overload's enumeration rather than to the originating overload's cast
